currency.basis: Operating official site currently offers retail/business banking and September 2026 notices. Current official header uses the same three-part orange emblem. No successor substitution or historical period choice is involved.

identity.basis: Official domain header alt text identifies Татсоцбанк; page describes AO ТАТСОЦБАНК and license 480. Finuslugi identifies AO ТАТСОЦБАНК with same license and displays this exact SVG as its logo.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official bank page supports identity/current visual use; Finuslugi independently identifies the bank and publishes the vector. variant.basis: Viewed downloaded official raster and rsvg-convert reference of original SVG: upright three separated orange pointed leaf/flame shapes, no accompanying text in candidate. SVG uses #EB6129, concise intentional bezier geometry, no embedded raster or tracing noise. Suitable standalone mark; official raster supports the emblem variant but does not establish exact vector RGB by itself.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Full source and original/final theme pairs retain all three pointed forms, curved contours and two transparent chevron gaps. Actual Desktop output has no clipping or lost detail.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Original narrow upright proportions and placement retained. Complete emblem fits with source clear space. candidate.role: Standalone transparent bank emblem without accompanying lettering.
